title: The First Voyage of Sindbad
summary: Sindbad the Sailor began the tale of his first voyage:
full_text:
Sindbad the Sailor began the tale of his first voyage:

'Having squandered much of my father’s inheritance in youthful folly, I resolved to embark on commerce. I purchased merchandise, boarded a merchant ship at Basra, and sailed down the Persian Gulf.

One sunny afternoon, the sea being calm, we sighted a green, pleasant island covered with flowering shrubs. The captain cast anchor, and the merchants went ashore to stroll, cook, and wash their garments.

We built a fire on the grass to prepare our meal. But suddenly, the ground trembled with a violent convulsion! The green island was not land at all, but the back of a colossal sleeping whale that had floated upon the waves until sand and trees had grown upon its hide! Warmed by our fire, the monstrous beast plunged into the ocean depths, dragging men and merchandise down into the abyss!

The ship hoisted sail and fled. I was cast into the sea, clinging to a floating wooden wash-tub. For a day and a night, the waves tossed me until I washed ashore on a mountainous island. Exhausted and bruised, I crawled into the shade of high trees and ate wild fruit.

Exploring the interior, I met the royal grooms of King Mihrjan, who were caring for the king’s pedigree mares. They conducted me to their capital, where King Mihrjan was so impressed by my manners and business acumen that he appointed me Chief Harbor Master of his port.

One day, a foreign ship arrived to unload its cargo. To my astonishment, the bales bore my own name and seal: it was the very ship from which I had been washed overboard!

I identified my goods, proved my identity before King Mihrjan, sold my cargo at enormous profit, and returned to Baghdad laden with pearls, aloes-wood, and gold, establishing my fortune through steadfast courage in disaster.'
moral: Courage, presence of mind, and honest enterprise rebuild life from the wreckage of disaster.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The First Voyage of Sindbad"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
